field_text_formatted.value: The reason it cannot read it is the interesting part. The only core permission that grants access to a text format's configuration is administer filters, which core itself flags restrict access. Hand it to an author and they can rewrite the text format, one of the shorter routes to an XSS. So the choice has been between a permission you cannot give them and a frontend guessing at a toolbar.
